steps.title: Establish App Meta-Configuration
steps.description: Establish the application meta descriptor containing app name 'Voice Control Assistant' and package identifier 'com.voicecontrolassistant.app'.

steps.title: Setup Main Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Configure settings.gradle to register the module and build.gradle with proper AGP 8.3.2 configuration.

steps.title: Configure Module Build Tooling
steps.description: Configure compile/target SDK version 34 and Java 8 compatibility options inside app/build.gradle.

steps.title: Define XML Drawables for AI Orb States
steps.description: Create background gradients for the modern breathing AI orb: Default, Listening, Processing, and Error states.

steps.title: Implement Floating AI Orb Layout
steps.description: Design an elegant custom UI overlay in floating_mic_layout.xml, combining text indicators and an animated glowing outer ripple.

steps.title: Configure App Main Layout UI
steps.description: Construct activity_main.xml to showcase real service status, permissions panel, usage guidelines, and detected apps.

steps.title: Declare System Permissions and Services
steps.description: Register QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES, RECORD_AUDIO, and SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW inside AndroidManifest.xml alongside the Accessibility Service.

steps.title: Configure Accessibility Service Rules
steps.description: Register required capabilities like window state retrieval, flag report view IDs, and interactive view permissions inside accessibility_service_config.xml.

steps.title: Implement App Main Dashboard Controller
steps.description: Add dynamic overlay/microphone permission checks, real accessibility status updates, and live-detected launcher app listing to MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Build AI Orb Controller & Speech Engine
steps.description: Implement continuous 10-minute speech recognition sessions, status transitions, and dynamic native pulsing animations.

steps.title: Build UI Automation & Parsing Core
steps.description: Implement recursive accessibility tree traversal, multi-attribute element matches, parent-click strategies, and search pipelines.

steps.title: Building Voice Control Assistant
steps.description: Initiate assembly and compilation of Voice Control Assistant into its final debug distribution.
